title: Engineering an inducible leukemia-associated transcription factor for human phagocyte production
author: Windisch, Roland
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate CD14+ monocytes from blood
steps.instruction: Collect peripheral blood from healthy donors, isolate PBMCs by density‑gradient centrifugation, then purify CD14+ monocytes using the Miltenyi Classical Monocyte Isolation Kit.

steps.title: Culture untransduced HSPCs 3 days
steps.instruction: Obtain untransduced hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) from healthy donors and culture them for 3 days in medium supplemented with IL‑3, IL‑6, SCF, TPO, GM‑CSF, and FLT3‑L.

steps.title: Transduce HSPCs and expand with Shield‑1
steps.instruction: Transduce HSPCs with the retroviral construct DD‑MLL‑ENL‑ires‑GFP; maintain the transduced cells in the same cytokine medium (IL‑3, IL‑6, SCF, TPO, GM‑CSF, FLT3‑L) in the presence of Shield‑1 for over 50 days to generate a GFP⁺, MLL‑ENL‑expressing progenitor population.

steps.title: Differentiate progenitors into macrophages
steps.instruction: Withdraw Shield‑1 from the GFP⁺ progenitor culture and culture the cells for 14 days in medium containing GM‑CSF, LPS, and IFNγ to obtain macrophages.

steps.title: Extract total RNA from each cell type
steps.instruction: Harvest cells from each of the four groups (untransduced HSPCs, DD‑MLL‑ENL‑GFP progenitors, derived macrophages, CD14⁺ monocytes) and isolate total RNA using the Qiagen RNeasy Plus Mini Kit.

steps.title: Perform NanoString expression profiling
steps.instruction: Analyze the isolated RNA on the NanoString nCounter Analysis System using the Myeloid Innate Immunity panel, including three biological replicates per cell type.

steps.title: Generate RNA‑seq data for MLL‑ENL cells
steps.instruction: Prepare three independent replicates of MLL‑ENL cells at progenitor and macrophage stages for transcriptomic profiling by RNA‑sequencing; compare resulting data to published hematopoietic RNA‑seq datasets.
